goal: Close the benchmark measurement-integrity gaps while preserving exact human authority for plugin installation and candidate application.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Harness and business outcomes validate, cluster, and reach optimizer evidence independently.
Evaluator-owned task rules, effect evidence, and journal replay fail closed under deterministic tests.
Candidate, service, and grader principals expose only their approved mounts, networks, and typed interfaces.
Approved manifests, receipts, persisted run records, summaries, and derived metrics bind without reusable or reassigned evidence.
G2 remains disabled source, arbitrary generation labels are rejected, and same-key locks require terminal evidence before release.
The latest source is rebuilt into an immutable benchmark image and the new image passes topology and sandbox probes.

outcome.summary: Source, contracts, focused integrity tests, the repository gate, and existing-image isolation probes passed. The latest-source image was not rebuilt because its Dockerfile installs a dsh plugin and no independent exact installation approval was available.

exception.reason: The image build performs a governed plugin installation without an approved, unexpired install_or_mount_plugin decision file.
exception.next_action: Issue and verify an independent exact plugin-installation decision, then rebuild the image, record its digest, rerun the probes, and emit a completed artifact-refresh record.

what_worked: Focused manifest, receipt, run-record, summary, topology, and G2 regressions passed.
The repository-wide typecheck, build, tests, capsule checks, policy check, and deterministic scorecards passed.
The existing image passed live three-principal topology and full-enforcement Linux sandbox probes.
what_failed: The final image artifact could not be refreshed without crossing the independent human-approval boundary.

calls.name: vitest
calls.purpose: Exercise focused benchmark evidence, topology, receipt, and branch regressions.

calls.name: pnpm run check
calls.purpose: Run the complete repository verification gate.

calls.name: capsule check
calls.purpose: Verify refreshed canonical-source digests and capsule freshness.

calls.name: live topology probe
calls.purpose: Exercise the existing image's isolated service and grader topology without a model call.

calls.name: sandbox probes
calls.purpose: Verify deterministic grading and expected out-of-workspace denial in the existing image.

failures_and_inefficiencies.summary: The final artifact refresh depends on a separate human decision that was unavailable at the installation boundary.
failures_and_inefficiencies.suggested_action: Have a project maintainer issue the exact scoped decision and rerun only the documented image-refresh steps.

evidence.summary: Focused e2e summary, topology, execution-receipt, and branch tests passed.
The full gate passed typecheck, build, 187 tests, capsule checks, policy validation, and both deterministic scorecards.
Both changed knowledge capsules validated against refreshed canonical source digests.
The existing image passed the live candidate/service/grader topology probe without a model call.
The existing image passed deterministic grading under full Landlock enforcement and denied an out-of-workspace write.
Final scoped and complete-worktree reviews reported no remaining findings after untracked additions were included.
The evidence matrix records the exact governed operation, missing approval class, existing-image limitation, owner, and recovery path.

uncertainty.statement: No immutable image identity exists for the latest source tree.
uncertainty.resolution: Rebuild and re-probe only after verifying the independent exact installation decision.

uncertainty.statement: No model-backed batch was executed, so the change has no model-quality evidence.
uncertainty.resolution: Prepare a new transmission manifest and obtain a separate exact data-transfer decision before any later model batch.

notes: A separate sensitive-action decision remains required; ordinary review or delegated agent judgment is not approval.
